# Paying Up For Tech Talent In China: Is The Tech Boom Pushing Wages Up To Silicon Valley Levels?

Rui Ma

Contributor

I write about technology in Greater China.

Following

May 26, 2015,09:16am EDT

Updated May 26, 2015, 09:45pm EDT

This article is more than 9 years old.

As an early stage tech investor with limited capital to deploy, I pay close attention to the market for technical talent. Cash burn per technical headcount, especially for young startups that have no or limited revenue, is one of the most important factors in determining how many months or “runway” a company has before it has to raise more capital, or more likely, shutter its doors.
